scenes.title: At night the lion council sits around the round
scenes.text: At night the lion council sits around the round table and debates who will take the quest, and Leo volunteers.

scenes.title: Around the campfire Leo and Pip plan the long ro
scenes.text:
Around the campfire Leo and Pip plan the long road to the valley of the sun.
Pip (concern): "If the egg gets cold before we reach the valley it will never hatch."
Leo (serious): "Then we do not rest until it is warm."
Pip (warm): "You carry the egg and I will watch the road."

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: If the egg gets cold before we reach the valley it will never hatch.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Then we do not rest until it is warm.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: You carry the egg and I will watch the road.

scenes.title: In his workshop Leo tinkers with clockwork gears
scenes.text: In his workshop Leo tinkers with clockwork gears and turns the crank of a music box that points the way.

scenes.title: Downstream Leo paddles a raft through the rapids
scenes.text: Downstream Leo paddles a raft through the rapids between the boulders of the canyon river.

scenes.title: Deep in the jungle Leo swings from vine to vine
scenes.text: Deep in the jungle Leo swings from vine to vine across a ravine toward the ancient temple.

scenes.title: Inside the desert temple a giant boulder is rele
scenes.text: Inside the desert temple a giant boulder is released and Leo outruns it, jumps the pit and slides under the closing door.

scenes.title: Around the campfire Pip warms the egg while Leo
scenes.text:
Around the campfire Pip warms the egg while Leo sharpens the quest map.
Pip (sad): "I heard the egg thieves behind us on the river road."
Leo (angry): "Then they will meet me at the bridge."
Pip (concern): "Be careful, Leo. They are many."

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: I heard the egg thieves behind us on the river road.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Then they will meet me at the bridge.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: Be careful, Leo. They are many.

scenes.title: Leo poles a punt through the mangrove swamp whil
scenes.text: Leo poles a punt through the mangrove swamp while crocodiles lunge from the dark water.

scenes.title: At night a stolen dinosaur egg lies in a prehist
scenes.text: At night a stolen dinosaur egg lies in a prehistoric valley beside a glowing volcano and Leo carries it back to its mother.

scenes.title: At noon a herd of wild horses gallops along the
scenes.text: At noon a herd of wild horses gallops along the river toward the mountains.

scenes.title: Leo rides a horse galloping across the plains an
scenes.text: Leo rides a horse galloping across the plains and jumps the fence.

scenes.title: At dusk an avalanche thunders down the snowy mou
scenes.text: At dusk an avalanche thunders down the snowy mountain and Leo outruns it with the cub.

scenes.title: At the foot of the mountains Leo climbs a sheer
scenes.text: At the foot of the mountains Leo climbs a sheer cliff to rescue a lost cub and swings across the gap on a rope.

scenes.title: Around the campfire the travellers rest after th
scenes.text:
Around the campfire the travellers rest after the mountain and the egg begins to glow.
Leo (joy): "Look, the egg is glowing. It knows we are close!"
Pip (joy): "Then we must reach the valley before sunrise."
Leo (warm): "We will, my friend."

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Look, the egg is glowing. It knows we are close!

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: Then we must reach the valley before sunrise.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: We will, my friend.

scenes.title: A wall of water floods the valley below and Leo
scenes.text: A wall of water floods the valley below and Leo rescues a child and carries it to the hill.

scenes.title: Leo sprints across the rotten rope bridge as the
scenes.text: Leo sprints across the rotten rope bridge as the planks fall away behind him.

scenes.title: In a storm Leo fights a sea serpent on the mast
scenes.text: In a storm Leo fights a sea serpent on the mast of a sailing ship.

scenes.title: In the ice cave Leo leaps between drifting ice f
scenes.text: In the ice cave Leo leaps between drifting ice floes while stalactites crash around him.

scenes.title: At sunset Leo rides a dragon through the canyon
scenes.text: At sunset Leo rides a dragon through the canyon between the rock spires and under the stone arch.

scenes.title: Leo crosses the floating city, riding the moving
scenes.text: Leo crosses the floating city, riding the moving platforms above the clouds.

scenes.title: A stone giant lifts its arm and Leo rides the pa
scenes.text: A stone giant lifts its arm and Leo rides the palm, walks to the shoulder and pulls the glowing core from its chest.

scenes.title: At noon in the gladiator arena Leo faces the riv
scenes.text: At noon in the gladiator arena Leo faces the rival lion in a duel before the roaring crowd.

scenes.title: Around the campfire at dawn Leo and Pip watch th
scenes.text:
Around the campfire at dawn Leo and Pip watch the egg crack open.
Pip (joy): "It is hatching, Leo. It is really hatching!"
Leo (warm): "Welcome to the world, little one."
Pip (warm): "You brought it home."

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: It is hatching, Leo. It is really hatching!

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.text: Welcome to the world, little one.

dialogue.speaker: Pip
dialogue.text: You brought it home.
